Limitations of the study include the use of a single-set training protocol, which as previously discussed is suboptimal for maximal hypertrophic gains, and different intensities of load between conditions. Results of a study by Martorelli and colleagues (140) lend some support to these findings, showing markedly greater increases in biceps brachii thickness in a cohort of active women who performed bilateral arm curls to failure compared to those who stopped short of failure (17.5% vs. 8.5%, respectively).
